title: Visiting Assistant Professor of Law
bio: Mailyn Fidler is an Assistant Professor at the University of New Hampshire Franklin Pierce School of Law. Fidler’s scholarship lies at the intersection of power and technology, critiquing the unaccountable ways that technology expands the power of government actors.
